name: Heal Palestine
mission: HEAL Palestine is a non-political nonprofit organization founded in January 2024, in response to the unimaginable devastation in Gaza, delivering urgent, lifesaving, and sustainable health care, education, humanitarian aid, and leadership development services across Palestine.
theoryOfChange: Our organization is committed to a strategic approach that addresses both the immediate needs and long-term empowerment of Palestinian children and their families. Founded in response to the devastation in Gaza, our mission is driven by four core pillars—Health, Education, Aid, and Leadership. Through these pillars, we strive not only to meet the basic needs of Palestinian children but also to empower them to unlock their full potential and become agents of positive change.
